source: owner review supplied in conversation on 2026-09-17
interpretation: These are reviewed segment labels for classifier calibration. Warmwater-no-trout means not a trout-stream fishery; it does not claim that every trout species is absent from a lake.

boone-tailwater.note: Reviewed as the trout stream below Boone Dam; do not merge it with Boone Lake.

boone-lake.note: Reviewed as the warmwater reservoir; trout catches do not convert the lake into the Boone tailwater trout system.

dale-hollow-lake.note: Reviewed as the warmwater reservoir; do not infer trout-stream status from seasonal or historic stocking evidence.

j-percy-priest-lake.note: Reviewed as a warmwater reservoir with no trout-stream classification.

duck-river-tailwater.note: Reviewed as the trout stream below Normandy Dam; do not merge it with the general Duck River reaches.

south-holston-lake.note: Reviewed as warmwater lake fishery even though lake trout are present; lake trout do not by themselves make the reservoir a trout stream or winter-stocked stream.

parksville-tailwater.note: Reviewed as the trout stream below Parksville Dam, the Ocoee No. 1 reach; keep this segment separate from Parksville Lake.

elk-river.note: Reviewed as the Tims Ford tailwater trout stream; do not let seasonal stocking months alone downgrade the stream classification.
